[FreeLLMAPI](https://github.com/tashfeenahmed/freellmapi) is an MIT-licensed, self-hosted gateway
that pools the free tiers of many LLM providers behind one local endpoint. It tracks each
provider's rate limits and falls over to the next one when a limit is hit. It speaks Anthropic's
Messages API, so Claude Code can run through it unchanged, and this skill needs no changes either.

It does the same job as OmniRoute ([`omniroute.md`](omniroute.md)). **Pick one gateway, not
both**; everything in that guide about what a gateway does and doesn't touch applies here too.

## What it changes

| Traffic | Goes through FreeLLMAPI? |
|---|---|
| The agent's own LLM calls (reading `SKILL.md`, writing prompts) | **Yes**, once Claude Code points at it |
| Higgsfield generations (CLI, MCP, web) | **No.** They go to Higgsfield directly and use your Higgsfield credits |
| `scripts/*.py` (preflight, lint, memory, validate) | **No.** They run locally and call no LLM |

It changes which model *writes* the prompt, never which Higgsfield model *renders* it or what
that costs.

## Install

One-liner (needs Docker; sets up `~/freellmapi` and starts it):

```bash
curl -fsSL https://freellmapi.co/install.sh | bash
```

Read [the script](https://freellmapi.co/install.sh) first if you prefer. On macOS and Windows
there's also a desktop app on the project's Releases page.

Open `http://localhost:3001`, add your provider keys on the **Keys** page, set the **Fallback
Chain**, and copy the unified key (`freellmapi-…`) from the Keys page header.

## Point Claude Code at it

The simplest route keeps the key out of config files:

```bash
npx freellmapi launch
```

Or write it into Claude Code's config (it backs up your existing config first):

```bash
npx freellmapi setup-claude --url http://localhost:3001 --api-key <unified-key>
```

By hand, Claude Code takes the **root** URL, not `…/v1`, because it adds `/v1/messages` itself:

```bash
export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="http://localhost:3001"
export ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="<unified-key>"
claude
```

Other agents (Codex, Cline, Aider, …) use `http://localhost:3001/v1`. Put these settings in your
user config, never in this repo's tracked `.claude/settings.json`.

## Settings that matter for this skill

- **Prompt compression: keep it `off` or `lossless`.** It's off by default. The `standard` and
  `aggressive` modes drop "stale" file reads and condense older turns, which can remove the
  skill's reference files and HARD RULES from what the model sees mid-task. That's the same risk
  as Caveman's file compression ([`caveman.md`](caveman.md)).
- **Don't use the `fusion` model for prompts.** It sends your request to several free models and
  has a judge model merge their drafts. A merged prompt isn't one the skill's checklist approved;
  ask for a single model.
- **Response cache.** It's opt-in. If you turn it on, a repeated request can return an earlier
  prompt; regenerate rather than reuse when the brief changed.
- **Check who served it.** Each response names the provider and model that answered
  (`X-Routed-Via`). Fallback can change the writer mid-session, so keep the chain to models of
  similar strength.

## Pick the writer with care

Free tiers are mostly smaller or rate-limited models. The skill assumes a model that reads long
reference files and follows numbered rules closely, so expect more misses from a small one:
wrong parameter values, skipped preflight, prompts over a model's length limit. Before spending
Higgsfield credits, always run:

```bash
python3 scripts/preflight.py --model <id> --param K=V --strict
```

and `python3 scripts/seedance_lint.py "<prompt>"` for Seedance prompts.

## Privacy

FreeLLMAPI stores your provider keys encrypted on your machine, and requests go straight from your
machine to the providers you enabled. But **many free tiers let the provider use what you send
to train or improve its models.** Read each enabled provider's terms before routing client briefs,
unreleased product names or reference descriptions through it, and leave a provider out of the
chain if its terms don't fit the job.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| Claude Code returns 404 on every request | `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` ends in `/v1`; use the root URL |
| 401 errors | Use the unified `freellmapi-…` key from the Keys page, not a provider key |
| Requests stall or fail at busy times | Free-tier limits are exhausted; add providers to the chain or wait |
| Skill not triggered | The skill is loaded by Claude Code, not the gateway: check the install path |
| Higgsfield calls fail | Not a gateway issue: check the Higgsfield CLI or MCP login |
